feeding_claim.verbatim: Our cattle graze on diverse pasture and eat hay in the winter; we do not feed them grain.

notes: Diversified family farm north of West Chester, between Kalona and Washington; Natasha, Nancy, Brian and Claire Wilson farm it. Read the homepage, how we farm (about our food), about the farm and shop-all pages (WebFetch summaries only, so recheck the verbatim quote). Bulk meat collection page failed to load. How we farm: 'We don't feed our cows grain'; pigs get a farm-made non-GMO feed, meat chickens non-GMO feed from a local mill, laying hens and ducks forage with a farm-made non-GMO mix. Category grass-finished is from the beef claim; pork, chicken and eggs are grain-supplemented pastured products. Duck eggs sold; ducks are not a listed species value, so they are only in products. Local delivery every other Thursday to the listed towns and every other Friday to Fairfield (checkout option 'Ship' means local delivery, not shipping); on-farm pickup by appointment; SNAP EBT accepted. Bulk: 1/4 or 1/2 beef deposit and 1/2 or whole hog deposit, both currently sold out. Products also carried by partners (Wild Woods Farm in Solon, Boyd's Bologna in Washington, Blueberry Bottom Farm in Brighton, Cafe Paradiso in Fairfield), not added as channels. No shipping found.
